title: Normalized geometric stalks of etale sum extension of space modules
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $j:Z\to X$ be representable etale. Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention] with the small etale structure sheaves and module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the enlarged ringed-site equivalence and localization [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. Let $j^*$ be restriction and let $j_!$ be its left adjoint given by module sheafification of the direct-sum presheaf [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Use the adjunction $j_!\dashv j^*$ normalized as follows: a morphism $\alpha:G\to j^*F$ corresponds to the morphism $j_!G\to F$ induced through module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] by the presheaf map sending $s$ in the $a$-summand $G(W\xrightarrow{a}Z)$ of the direct-sum presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] to $\alpha_{(W,a)}(s)\in F(W)$; all units and counits below are those of this adjunction. A geometric point is a map $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed; stalks are colimits over pointed etale scheme neighbourhoods [lem-sfb-space-geometric-points-conservative]. Write $L_j(\bar x)=\{\bar z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Z\mid j\bar z=\bar x\}$. For every $\mathcal O_Z$-module $G$ there is a natural $\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$-linear isomorphism
$$(j_!G)_{\bar x}\cong\bigoplus_{\bar z\in L_j(\bar x)}G_{\bar z},$$
using the canonical stalk-ring identifications for etale restriction. It sends a section $s\in G(W\xrightarrow{a}Z)$ in the $a$-summand on a pointed etale scheme neighbourhood $(W,\bar w)$ of $\bar x$ to its germ in the summand indexed by $a\bar w$. In particular, for a module $F$ on $X$, the identifications $(j^*F)_{\bar z}\cong F_{\bar x}$ identify $(j_!j^*F)_{\bar x}$ with $\bigoplus_{L_j(\bar x)}F_{\bar x}$, and the adjunction counit induces the sum of the identity maps on these summands. If $k:Z'\to Z$ is representable etale, the map $(jk)_!(jk)^*F\to j_!j^*F$ induced by the counit for $k$ sends the summand indexed by $\bar z'$ to the summand indexed by $k\bar z'$ by the identity on $F_{\bar x}$. No finiteness or separation hypothesis on $j$ or $k$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model] to identify the ringed small etale module category of $Z$ with the slice over $Z$ in the enlarged site of $X$. Thus the left adjoint of [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] is the sheafification of $P_G(W)=\bigoplus_{a:W\to Z/X}G(W,a)$, with exactly the restrictions in [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]. The canonical natural isomorphism of [lem-sfb-space-sum-extension-geometric-stalk] applies to this same construction. It gives the asserted $\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$-linear stalk isomorphism, the canonical stalk-ring identifications, and the specified formula $[s]_a\mapsto [s]_{a\bar w}$. All its hypotheses are precisely ours: representable etale $j$, structure-sheaf modules and the fixed small-site universes. In particular it permits empty and infinite lift sets and does not assume separation.

proof.text: For $G=j^*F$, localization identifies $j^*$ with inverse image, by [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. Apply the natural geometric-point identification $(j^{-1}F)_{\bar z}\cong F_{j\bar z}$ of [lem-sfb-space-geometric-points-conservative], including its compatibility with stalk rings and algebraic operations. Since $j\bar z=\bar x$, and the structural ring map is an isomorphism by [lem-sfb-space-sum-extension-geometric-stalk], this is an $\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$-linear identification $(j^*F)_{\bar z}\cong F_{\bar x}$. Substitution into the direct sum gives the required normalized description of $(j_!j^*F)_{\bar x}$.

proof.text: Compute the adjunction normalization explicitly. For a module morphism $\alpha:G\to j^*F$, send $s$ in the $a$-summand of $P_G(W)$ to $\alpha_{(W,a)}(s)\in F(W)$. These maps commute with restrictions and are linear by [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]; hence [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] extends them uniquely to $j_!G\to F$. Conversely a map $\beta:j_!G\to F$ gives $G(W,a)\to F(W)$ by the inclusion of the $a$-summand followed by $P_G\to j_!G\to F$. Naturality of $\beta$ makes this a morphism on the slice. The two operations are inverse: the first composite fixes each $a$-summand, while the second agrees with $\beta$ after $P_G\to j_!G$ and is equal to it by uniqueness of sheafification. Both operations are visibly natural in $G$ and $F$ (summandwise formulas), so this is an adjunction between the functors of [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], namely the normalized one fixed in the statement. Taking $\alpha=\mathrm{id}_{j^*F}$ shows that its counit evaluates every $a$-summand by $s\mapsto s\in F(W)$. The representative formula in [lem-sfb-space-sum-extension-geometric-stalk] therefore makes the counit the identity on each normalized stalk summand; by the defining universal property of a direct sum it is the sum of these identities.

proof.text: For $Z'\xrightarrow{k}Z\xrightarrow{j}X$, restriction is literal iterated restriction in the enlarged localized sites by [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. The unit for $k$ inserts $s\in G(W,b)$ into the $b$-summand on the $Z$-slice, by the previous step. Define the canonical comparison $c:(jk)_!G\to j_!k_!G$ as the adjunct of $G\to k^*k_!G\to k^*j^*j_!k_!G$, the two unit maps. By the Hom-bijection formula just proved and [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], a $b:W\to Z'$ generator maps under $c$ to the $a=kb$ summand for $j$, with inner element the $b$-summand generator for $k$. Put $G=(jk)^*F=k^*j^*F$ and follow $c$ by $j_!$ of the $k$-counit. The inner generator evaluates to $s\in(j^*F)(W,kb)$, by step 3, so the resulting map sends the $b$-summand to the $kb$-summand without changing $s$. Applying the normalized representative formulas of [lem-sfb-space-sum-extension-geometric-stalk] for $jk$ and $j$ sends $\bar z'=b\bar w$ to $k\bar z'$ with the identity on $F_{\bar x}$. Every element of a direct sum has finite support; this formula specifies a map for infinite fibres too, and adds terms when different $\bar z'$ have the same image. This is the counit-induced map under the canonical composite-adjunction comparison.

lean.statement: theorem space_etale_sum_stalks (j : Z ⟶ X) (hj : IsEtale j.hom.hom) (L : Z.Modules ⥤ X.Modules) (adj : L ⊣ pullback j hj) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (x : yoneda.obj (Over.mk s) ⟶ X.obj.obj) : (∀ z : EtaleGeometricLift j x, Function.Bijective (etaleLiftRingMap j s x z)) ∧ (∀ M : Z.Modules, Function.Bijective (etaleSumStalkMap j hj L adj s x M)) ∧ (∀ (M N : Z.Modules) (a : M ⟶ N) (z : EtaleGeometricLift j x) (m : (etaleLiftStalk j s x z).obj M), (SingleComplex.stalkModel s x).modules.map (L.map a) (etaleSumStalkInjection j hj L adj s x z M m) = etaleSumStalkInjection j hj L adj s x z N ((etaleLiftStalk j s x z).map a m)) ∧ (∀ F : X.Modules, Function.Bijective (etaleConstantSumStalkMap j hj L adj s x F)) ∧ (∀ (F : X.Modules) (z : EtaleGeometricLift j x) (m : (SingleComplex.stalkModel s x).modules.obj F), (SingleComplex.stalkModel s x).modules.map (adj.counit.app F) (etaleConstantStalkInjection j hj L adj s x z F m) = m) ∧ (∀ (Y : AlgebraicSpace S) (k : Y ⟶ Z) (hk : IsEtale k.hom.hom) (L' : Y.Modules ⥤ X.Modules) (adj' : L' ⊣ pullback (k ≫ j) (isEtale_comp k.hom.hom j.hom.hom hk hj)) (F : X.Modules) (z' : EtaleGeometricLift (k ≫ j) x) (z : EtaleGeometricLift j x), z'.val ≫ k.hom.hom = z.val → ∀ m : (SingleComplex.stalkModel s x).modules.obj F, (SingleComplex.stalkModel s x).modules.map (etaleNestedStalkCounit k j hk hj L adj L' adj' F) (etaleConstantStalkInjection (k ≫ j) (isEtale_comp k.hom.hom j.hom.hom hk hj) L' adj' s x z' F m) = etaleConstantStalkInjection j hj L adj s x z F m)
lean.note: The theorem is uniform in a realizing adjunction L ⊣ literal étale restriction.
